The remaining open point is what happens to active report filters when the user switches workspaces. Today they carry over and can hide rows in the new workspace. Which behavior should the new report-view setting control?

A) Clear all filters on every workspace switch. The setting only chooses whether this reset happens, with reset as the default.
B) Store filters per workspace. Switching restores that workspace's last filters, and the setting chooses per-workspace or global memory.

other - name it
